target.summary: The stream converter's heuristics for detecting malformed responses misclassify valid streamed tool calls as malformed, causing shouldDropMalformedAttempt and shouldHoldUntrustedParts to clear response parts and suppress finish_reason to undefined. This silently drops tool calls and breaks tool execution across streaming turns.
notes: faulty logic clearing response parts when misclassified as malformed
implementation of hasNamelessToolCall helper that misclassifies tool calls as nameless
suppression of finish_reason to undefined when shouldDropMalformedAttempt is set
skipping tool call emission when shouldDropMalformedAttempt is set
call site of hasNamelessToolCall and condition determining malformedNamelessToolCall
